name: docker-self-host
title: Docker image, compose with a Cloudflare tunnel, and the web auth that goes with it
summary: A web app served by its own Node server, shipped as one multi-arch Docker image (ghcr.io) plus a Node tarball, with an optional cloudflared service and the sign-in code (setup code, scrypt, hashed sessions and tokens, same-site check, login lockout) that is safe behind a tunnel.
